General-content county map also showing marshes, rural buildings, and householders' names; the Amboy insets also show buildings, occupants' names, and some property lot lines. Hand colored to emphasize municipal (city/borough/township) boundaries and territories. Prime meridian: New York. Map sheets mounted on cloth backing to form northern/southern segments. LC copy imperfect: Darkened, fold-lined, originally printed in multiple sections (later conjoined), mounted on cloth backing that replaces the original backing, missing small sections at edges and at internal fold lines. Includes 11 town/village insets (including New Brunswick, Perth Amboy, South Amboy), local business directories, distance table, and illustrations of prominent buildings.
